articles.summary: Introduction If you want to increase subscription signups on Shopify, a bigger subscribe-and-save discount is a weak lever. It costs margin on the first order and on every renewal after it. It also tells shoppers the price was never the real price. That's a hard lesson to unteach. Shoppers subscribe for better reasons
articles.title: How to Increase Subscription Signups on Shopify (2026): 6 Offers Beyond 10% Off
